title: 2042. Check if Numbers Are Ascending in a Sentence

examples.input: s = "1 box has 3 blue 4 red 6 green and 12 yellow marbles"
examples.explanation: The numbers in s are: 1, 3, 4, 6, 12. They are strictly increasing from left to right: 1 < 3 < 4 < 6 < 12.
The numbers in s are: 5, 5. They are not strictly increasing.
